class TreeNode:
    def __init__(self, val=0, left=None, right=None):
        self.val = val
        self.left = left
        self.right = right

def convertToDLL(root):
    def extractLeaves(node):
        if not node:
            return None, None
        
        if not node.left and not node.right:
            # This is a leaf node
            return node, node
        
        left_head, left_tail = extractLeaves(node.left)
        right_head, right_tail = extractLeaves(node.right)
        
        # Remove leaf nodes from the tree
        if left_head:
            node.left = None
        if right_head:
            node.right = None
        
        # Connect the left and right parts
        if left_tail:
            left_tail.right = right_head
        if right_head:
            right_head.left = left_tail
        
        # Determine the head and tail of the DLL
        head = left_head if left_head else right_head
        tail = right_tail if right_tail else left_tail
        
        return head, tail
    
    head, _ = extractLeaves(root)
    return head
